description_en: Query an Alibaba Cloud CDN accelerated domain name.
kebab_example: aliyun mpserverless describe-cdn-domain --space-id mp-05c3aa1c-0000-43ae-a03d-61eff91c592e --type FILE --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCdnDomain

parameters.help_en:
Supports management of custom domain names for cloud storage and static websites:  
FILE: Alibaba Cloud CDN for cloud storage  
WEB: Alibaba Cloud CDN for static website hosting (requires a custom domain name to be attached to CDN)
parameters.help_zh:
支持对云存储和静态网站自定义域名进行管理：
FILE 云存储CDN
WEB 静态网站托管CDN（前提是已经绑定自定义CDN）

AuthConfig.description_en: Alibaba Cloud CDN authentication configuration. Valid only in "FILE" mode.
AuthConfig.description_zh: CDN鉴权配置，仅“FILE”模式下有效

AuthDelta.description_en: Default validity period (in seconds) for authentication.

AuthKey.description_en: Authentication key, 6 to 128 characters long, used to compute the Authentication Signature.
AuthKey.description_zh: 鉴权密钥，6~128位，用于计算鉴权签名

AuthType.description_en:
Authentication type. Enumeration values:  
no_auth: Authentication is not enabled.  
type_a: Type A authentication.  
type_b: Type B authentication.  
type_c: Type C authentication.  

For more information, see Authentication Methods and Principles (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85113.htm).
AuthType.description_zh:
鉴权类型，枚举值：
no_auth 当前未开启鉴权。
type_a A方式鉴权。
type_b B方式鉴权。
ype_c C方式鉴权。

更多参考：鉴权方式及原理说明 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85113.htm)

AccessOriginControl.description_en:
true: Enables cross-origin authentication. Each request is checked against the CORS rules.  
false: Disables cross-origin validation. The configured CORS response headers are returned unconditionally.
AccessOriginControl.description_zh:
true：开启跨域验证，每次请求都会检查是否符合跨域规则。
false：不开启跨域校验，固定返回已配置的跨域头

AllowOrigin.description_en:
Set the cross-origin validation rule. The default value is “*”. The cross-origin validation rules are as follows:  
If set to “*”, the response header “Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *” is always returned, regardless of whether the user request includes the “Origin” parameter or what value the “Origin” parameter carries.  
If one or more values are configured for the CORS response header (multiple values separated by commas):  
If the “Origin” parameter in the request header exactly matches any of the configured values, the corresponding CORS response header is returned.  
If no exact match is found, no CORS response header is returned.  
If a wildcard domain name is configured, the system validates whether the “Origin” value in the request header matches the wildcard pattern.
AllowOrigin.description_zh:
设置跨域校验规则，默认为“*”，跨域校验规则为：
设置为“\”，不论用户请求里面是否携带“Origin”参数，也不论携带的“Origin”参数为何值，都固定返回“Access-Control-Allow-Origin:”。
跨域资源共享的响应头值设置了单个或者多个值（多个值之间用“,”分隔）。
如果用户请求头里携带的“Origin”参数值与被设置的任意一个值精确匹配，就会响应对应的跨域头。
如果都没有精确匹配上，则不响应跨域头。
设置为通配符域名，则会校验请求头中Origin值是否能匹配上

DomainName.description_en: Alibaba Cloud CDN accelerated domain name.

IpList.description_en:
IP list, with multiple entries separated by commas (,). CIDR notation for network segments is supported.  
You can configure up to approximately 700 IPv6 addresses or 2000 IPv4 addresses.  

For more information, see IP address validation pattern (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27138.htm#section-6dp-9h1-ty3).
IpList.description_zh:
IP列表，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔。支持设置网段。
最多可配置约700个IPv6地址，2000个IPv4地址。

更多参考：IP地址校验模式 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27138.htm#section-6dp-9h1-ty3)

Type.description_en:
white: whitelist  
black: blacklist  

Blacklists and whitelists are mutually exclusive. You can enable only one type at a time.
Type.description_zh:
white： 白名单
black： 黑名单

黑名单和白名单互斥，同一时间您只能选择其中一种方式

AllowEmpty.description_en:
Specifies whether requests with an empty Referer field are allowed to access Alibaba Cloud CDN resources. Valid values:  
on: Allowed.  
off (Default Value): Not allowed.
AllowEmpty.description_zh:
是否允许空referer字段访问CDN资源。取值：
on：允许。
off（默认值）：禁止

DisableAst.description_en:
Specifies whether to use exact match mode to control whether the domain names entered in the list are matched exactly. If this option is enabled (on), domain names are matched exactly.  
When the value is set to on:  
Exact match is supported.  
    - If example.com is added to the list, only example.com matches.  
    - If a*b.example.com is added to the list, it matches a<any character>b.example.com.  
Suffix matching is not supported.  
When the value is set to off (default):  
Exact match is not supported.  
Suffix matching is supported.  
    - If example.com is added to the list, both example.com and <any character>.example.com match.  
    - If a*b.example.com is added to the list, both a<any character>b.example.com and <any character>.a<any character>b.example.com match.
DisableAst.description_zh:
是否使用精确匹配模式，控制“名单列表”项中填写的域名是否为精确匹配。如果勾选（on）则精确匹配域名。
取值为on时：
支持精确匹配。
    - 名单列表填写example.com，匹配example.com。
    -  名单列表填写a*b.example.com，匹配a<任意字符>b.example.com。
不支持后缀匹配。
取值为off（默认值）时：
不支持精确匹配。
支持后缀匹配。
    - 名单列表填写example.com，匹配example.com和<任意字符>.example.com。
     - 名单列表填写a*b.example.com，匹配a<任意字符>b.example.com和<任意字符>.a<任意字符>b.example.com

ReferList.description_en:

The total length of the Referer hotlink protection rule must not exceed 60 KB.
ReferList.description_zh:

Referer防盗链规则的总长度最长不超过60 KB

UaList.description_en:
Enter the User-Agent. Wildcard character * (matches any string) and multiple values (separated by |) are supported. For example: \curl\|\IE\|\chrome\|\firefox.  
If you need to apply access control to user requests that include the User-Agent request header but have an empty value, you can use the parameter this-is-empty-ua to represent an empty User-Agent value.
UaList.description_zh:
填写User-Agent，支持通配符号（匹配任意字符串）和多个值（多个值用|分割。例如：\curl\|\IE\|\chrome\|\firefox*）。
如果您需要对用户请求中携带了User-Agent请求头，但是值为空的情况做访问控制，您可以使用参数this-is-empty-ua来表示User-Agent值为空
